partial def leBytesAux (z : Int) (n : Nat) : List UInt8 :=
  if n = 0 then []
  else ((z land 255).toNat.toUInt8) :: leBytesAux (z >>> 8) (n - 1)

theorem leBytesAux_length (z : Int) (n : Nat) : (leBytesAux z n).length = n := by
  induction n generalizing z with
  | zero =>
    unfold leBytesAux
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold leBytesAux
    by_cases hn : succ n = 0
    contradiction
    rw [hn]
    rw [ih (z >>> 8)]

def leBytes (z : Int) (n : Nat) : Vector UInt8 n :=
  ⟨(leBytesAux z n).reverse, by rw [length_reverse, leBytesAux_length]⟩

theorem leBytes_get (z : Int) (n : Nat) (i : Fin n) : (leBytes z n).get i = ((z >>> (8 * (n - 1 - i.val))) land 255).toNat.toUInt8 := by
  unfold leBytes
  rw [get_eq_get_last]
  have h : (leBytesAux z n).length = n := leBytesAux_length z n
  rw [get_last_eq_nthLe _ _ (by linarith [i.is_lt])]
  rw [nthLe_reverse _ _ _ (by linarith)]
  have hi : n - i.val - 1 < n := by linarith [i.is_lt]
  rw [nthLe_leBytesAux z n (n - i.val - 1) hi]
  ring

theorem leBytesAux_cons (z : Int) (n : Nat) (h : n ≠ 0) : leBytesAux z n = ((z land 255).toNat.toUInt8) :: leBytesAux (z >>> 8) (n - 1) := by
  unfold leBytesAux
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  contradiction
  rfl

theorem nthLe_leBytesAux (z : Int) (n : Nat) (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : (leBytesAux z n).nthLe i hi = ((z >>> (8 * i)) land 255).toNat.toUInt8 := by
  induction n generalizing z i with
  | zero =>
    linarith [hi]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [leBytesAux_cons _ _ (succ_ne_zero n)]
    by_cases h0 : i = 0
    rw [h0]
    unfold nthLe
    simp [land, >>>_0]
    have hi' : i - 1 < n := by linarith [h0]
    unfold nthLe
    rw [nthLe_cons_succ]
    rw [ih (z >>> 8) (i - 1) hi']
    ring

def compress (h : Vector UInt32 8) (w : Vector UInt32 64) : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  (0 to 63).foldl h (fun hs i =>
    let a := hs.get 0
    let b := hs.get 1
    let c := hs.get 2
    let d := hs.get 3
    let e := hs.get 4
    let f := hs.get 5
    let g := hs.get 6
    let h' := hs.get 7
    let t1 := h' + bsigma1 e + ch e f g + sha256_k.get i + w.get i
    let t2 := bsigma0 a + maj a b c
    ⟨[t1 + t2, a, b, c, d + t1, e, f, g], by rfl⟩
  )

theorem compress_length (h : Vector UInt32 8) (w : Vector UInt32 64) : (compress h w).length = 8 := by
  unfold compress
  induction (0 to 63) h with
  | init => rfl
  | step i hs ih =>
    unfold foldl
    rfl

def UInt32.ofBEBytes4 (b : Vector UInt8 4) : UInt32 :=
  b.get 0 |>.toUInt32 <<< 24 ||| b.get 1 |>.toUInt32 <<< 16 ||| b.get 2 |>.toUInt32 <<< 8 ||| b.get 3 |>.toUInt32

theorem ofBEBytes4_get (b : Vector UInt8 4) (i : Fin 4) : ((ofBEBytes4 b >>> (8 * (3 - i.val))) land 255) = b.get i := by
  cases i.val with
  | 0 =>
    unfold ofBEBytes4
    linarith
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | 0 =>
      unfold ofBEBytes4
      linarith
    | succ m =>
      cases m with
      | 0 =>
        unfold ofBEBytes4
        linarith
      | succ =>
        unfold ofBEBytes4
        linarith

def compression (h : Vector UInt32 8) (block : Vector UInt8 64) : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  let w0 := ⟨(0 to 15).map (fun j => UInt32.ofBEBytes4 ⟨block.toList.drop (j * 4).take 4, by linarith⟩), by linarith⟩
  let w := ⟨w0.toList ++ (16 to 63).map (fun i => ssigma1 (w0.get ⟨i - 2, by linarith⟩) + w0.get ⟨i - 7, by linarith⟩ + ssigma0 (w0.get ⟨i - 15, by linarith⟩) + w0.get ⟨i - 16, by linarith⟩), by linarith⟩
  let h' := compress h w
  ⟨(0 to 7).map (fun i => h.get ⟨i, by linarith⟩ + h'.get ⟨i, by linarith⟩), by linarith⟩

theorem compression_length (h : Vector UInt32 8) (block : Vector UInt8 64) : (compression h block).length = 8 := by
  unfold compression
  rfl

def pad (data : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := data.length
  let bit_len := (len * 8).toUInt64
  let mod_len := len % 64
  let pad_zeros := if mod_len < 56 then 55 - mod_len else 119 - mod_len
  let pad := data ++ [0x80] ++ List.replicate pad_zeros 0
  let pad_len := writeLEUInt64 bit_len |>.toList
  pad ++ pad_len

theorem pad_mod64_zero (data : List UInt8) : (pad data).length % 64 = 0 := by
  unfold pad
  let len := data.length
  let mod_len := len % 64
  by_cases h : mod_len < 56
  calc
    (len + 1 + (55 - mod_len) + 8) % 64 = (len % 64 + (1 + (55 - mod_len) + 8) % 64) % 64 := by rw [add_mod, add_mod, add_mod]
    _ = (mod_len + 0) % 64 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 + (55 - mod_len) + 8 = 64 - mod_len < 64 by linarith)]
    _ = mod_len := by rw [add_zero]
  calc
    (len + 1 + (119 - mod_len) + 8) % 64 = (len % 64 + (1 + (119 - mod_len) + 8) % 64) % 64 := by rw [add_mod, add_mod, add_mod]
    _ = (mod_len + 0) % 64 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 + (119 - mod_len) + 8 = 128 - mod_len < 128 by linarith), Nat.add_mod_right]
    _ = mod_len := by rw [add_zero]

theorem pad_larger (data : List UInt8) : (pad data).length ≥ data.length := by
  unfold pad
  linarith

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let padded := pad data
  let num_blocks := padded.length / 64
  let final_h := (0 to num_blocks - 1).foldl sha256_h_init (fun h b =>
    let block := ⟨padded.drop (b * 64) |>.take 64, by linarith⟩
    compression h block
  )
  ⟨final_h.toList.bind (fun word =>
    [(word >>> 24).toUInt8, (word >>> 16).toUInt8, (word >>> 8).toUInt8, word.toUInt8]), by linarith⟩

theorem sha256_length (data : List UInt8) : (sha256 data).length = 32 := by
  unfold sha256
  linarith

theorem sha256_determ (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) : sha256 d1 = sha256 d2 := by
  rw [h]

def hashTripletFields (subject relation object : String) (confidence : Float) (extraction_time : Int) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let subject_b := subject.toUTF8.toList
  let relation_b := relation.toUTF8.toList
  let object_b := object.toUTF8.toList
  let conf_bits := confidence.bitCastToUInt64
  let conf_le := writeLEUInt64 conf_bits |>.toList
  let time_le := Int.toLEBytes16 extraction_time |>.toList
  let input := subject_b ++ [0] ++ relation_b ++ [0] ++ object_b ++ [0] ++ conf_le ++ time_le
  sha256 input

theorem hashTripletFields_length (s r o : String) (c : Float) (t : Int) : (hashTripletFields s r o c t).length = 32 := by
  unfold hashTripletFields
  rw [sha256_length]

theorem hashTripletFields_determ (s1 r1 o1 c1 t1 s2 r2 o2 c2 t2 : _) (h : s1 = s2 ∧ r1 = r2 ∧ o1 = o2 ∧ c1 = c2 ∧ t1 = t2) : hashTripletFields s1 r1 o1 c1 t1 = hashTripletFields s2 r2 o2 c2 t2 := by
  unfold hashTripletFields
  rw [h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2, h.2.2.2]
  rfl

def hashTripletIdentity (subject relation object : String) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let subject_b := subject.toUTF8.toList
  let relation_b := relation.toUTF8.toList
  let object_b := object.toUTF8.toList
  let input := subject_b ++ [0] ++ relation_b ++ [0] ++ object_b

  unfold hashTripletIdentity
  rw [h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2]
  rfl

structure RelationalTriplet where
  subject : String
  relation : String
  object : String
  confidence : Float
  source_hash : Vector UInt8 32
  extraction_time : Int
  allocator : Unit
  metadata : HashMap String String

theorem RelationalTriplet.ext (a b : RelationalTriplet) (h1 : a.subject = b.subject) (h2 : a.relation = b.relation) (h3 : a.object = b.object) (h4 : a.confidence = b.confidence) (h5 : a.source_hash = b.source_hash) (h6 : a.extraction_time = b.extraction_time) (h7 : a.allocator = b.allocator) (h8 : a.metadata = b.metadata) : a = b := by
  cases a
  cases b
  congr

def RelationalTriplet.init (allocator : Unit) (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : Float) : RelationalTriplet :=
  { subject := subject
    relation := relation
    object := object
    confidence := clamp01 confidence_in
    source_hash := hashTripletIdentity subject relation object
    extraction_time := 0
    allocator := allocator
    metadata := empty }

theorem init_conf (a : Unit) (s r o : String) (c : Float) : (RelationalTriplet.init a s r o c).confidence = clamp01 c := by
  unfold RelationalTriplet.init
  rfl

theorem init_hash (a : Unit) (s r o : String) (c : Float) : (RelationalTriplet.init a s r o c).source_hash = hashTripletIdentity s r o := by
  unfold RelationalTriplet.init
  rfl

def RelationalTriplet.initWithHash (allocator : Unit) (subject relation object : String) (confidence_in : Float) (source_hash : Vector UInt8 32) (extraction_time : Int) : RelationalTriplet :=
  { subject := subject
    relation := relation
    object := object
    confidence := clamp01 confidence_in
    source_hash := source_hash
    extraction_time := extraction_time
    allocator := allocator
    metadata := empty }

  unfold RelationalTriplet.initWithHash
  rfl

def RelationalTriplet.deinit (self : RelationalTriplet) : Unit :=
  ()

def RelationalTriplet.clone (self : RelationalTriplet) (allocator : Unit) : RelationalTriplet :=
  { subject := self.subject
    relation := self.relation
    object := self.object
    confidence := self.confidence
    source_hash := self.source_hash
    extraction_time := self.extraction_time
    allocator := allocator

  unfold RelationalTriplet.clone

  unfold RelationalTriplet.clone
  rfl

def RelationalTriplet.computeHash (self : RelationalTriplet) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  hashTripletFields self.subject self.relation self.object self.confidence self.extraction_time

theorem computeHash_length (self : RelationalTriplet) : (self.computeHash).length = 32 := by
  unfold RelationalTriplet.computeHash
  rw [hashTripletFields_length]

def hexDigit (n : UInt8) (h : n < 16) : Char :=

def byteToHexLower (b : UInt8) : String :=
  let h1 := (b >>> 4) land 0xf
  let h2 := b land 0xf
  let d1 := hexDigit h1 (by linarith [UInt8.land_le, UInt8.shiftr_le])
  let d2 := hexDigit h2 (by linarith [UInt8.land_le])
  String.singleton d1 ++ String.singleton d2

  unfold byteToHexLower
  rw [length_append, length_singleton, length_singleton]
  linarith

  arr.foldl "" (fun acc b => acc ++ byteToHexLower b)

  unfold arrayToHexLower
  induction arr using Array.inductionOn with
  | h l ih =>
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      rfl
    | cons h t ih =>
      unfold foldl
      rw [ih]
      rw [byteToHexLower_length]
      linarith

def RelationalTriplet.toGraphElements (self : RelationalTriplet) (allocator : Unit) : struct { subject_node : Node, object_node : Node, edge : Edge } :=
  let subject_hash := sha256 self.subject.toUTF8.toList
  let subject_id := subject_hash.take 16
  let subject_id_str := arrayToHexLower subject_id.toArray
  let object_hash := sha256 self.object.toUTF8.toList
  let object_id := object_hash.take 16
  let object_id_str := arrayToHexLower object_id.toArray
  let c := clamp01 self.confidence
  let imag_sq := 1.0 - c * c
  let imag := Real.sqrt (max imag_sq 0.0)
  let quantum_state := ⟨c, imag⟩
  let period_ns := 360 * 1_000_000_000
  let mod_ns := self.extraction_time % period_ns
  let phase := mod_ns.toFloat / period_ns.toFloat * Real.pi * 2.0
  let subject_node := Node.initWithComplex allocator subject_id_str self.subject quantum_state phase
  let subject_node := subject_node.setMetadata "type" "entity"
  let subject_node := subject_node.setMetadata "role" "subject"
  let object_node := Node.initWithComplex allocator object_id_str self.object quantum_state phase
  let object_node := object_node.setMetadata "type" "entity"
  let object_node := object_node.setMetadata "role" "object"
  let edge := Edge.initWithComplex allocator subject_id_str object_id_str .coherent c quantum_state 1.0
  let edge := edge.setMetadata "relation" self.relation
  let conf_str := c.toString
  let edge := edge.setMetadata "confidence" conf_str
  { subject_node := subject_node, object_node := object_node, edge := edge }

  induction n generalizing z with
  | zero =>
    unfold leBytesAux
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold leBytesAux
    by_cases hn : succ n = 0
    contradiction
    rw [hn]
    rw [ih (z >>> 8)]

def leBytes (z : Int) (n : Nat) : Vector UInt8 n :=
  ⟨(leBytesAux z n).reverse, by rw [length_reverse, leBytesAux_length]⟩

theorem leBytes_get (z : Int) (n : Nat) (i : Fin n) : (leBytes z n).get i = ((z >>> (8 * (n - 1 - i.val))) land 255).toNat.toUInt8 := by
  unfold leBytes
  rw [get_eq_get_last]
  have h : (leBytesAux z n).length = n := leBytesAux_length z n
  rw [get_last_eq_nthLe _ _ (by linarith [i.is_lt])]
  rw [nthLe_reverse _ _ _ (by linarith)]
  have hi : n - i.val - 1 < n := by linarith [i.is_lt]
  rw [nthLe_leBytesAux z n (n - i.val - 1) hi]
  ring

theorem leBytesAux_cons (z : Int) (n : Nat) (h : n ≠ 0) : leBytesAux z n = ((z land 255).toNat.toUInt8) :: leBytesAux (z >>> 8) (n - 1) := by
  unfold leBytesAux
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  contradiction
  rfl

theorem nthLe_leBytesAux (z : Int) (n : Nat) (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : (leBytesAux z n).nthLe i hi = ((z >>> (8 * i)) land 255).toNat.toUInt8 := by
  induction n generalizing z i with
  | zero =>
    linarith [hi]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [leBytesAux_cons _ _ (succ_ne_zero n)]
    by_cases h0 : i = 0
    rw [h0]
    unfold nthLe
    simp [land, >>>_0]
    have hi' : i - 1 < n := by linarith [h0]
    unfold nthLe
    rw [nthLe_cons_succ]
    rw [ih (z >>> 8) (i - 1) hi']
    ring

theorem ch_comm (x y z : UInt32) : ch x y z = ch x z y := by

  rw [land_comm y z, lxor_comm]

def maj (x y z : UInt32) : UInt32 := (x land y) lxor (x land z) lxor (y land z)

theorem maj_assoc (x y z : UInt32) : maj x y z = maj y x z := by
  unfold maj

def bsigma0 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 := x.rotr 2 lxor x.rotr 13 lxor x.rotr 22

def bsigma1 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 := x.rotr 6 lxor x.rotr 11 lxor x.rotr 25

def ssigma0 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 := x.rotr 7 lxor x.rotr 18 lxor (x >>> 3)

def ssigma1 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 := x.rotr 17 lxor x.rotr 19 lxor (x >>> 10)

].toList, by rfl⟩

def compress (h : Vector UInt32 8) (w : Vector UInt32 64) : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  (0 to 63).foldl h (fun hs i =>
    let a := hs.get 0
    let b := hs.get 1
    let c := hs.get 2
    let d := hs.get 3
    let e := hs.get 4
    let f := hs.get 5
    let g := hs.get 6
    let h' := hs.get 7
    let t1 := h' + bsigma1 e + ch e f g + sha256_k.get i + w.get i
    let t2 := bsigma0 a + maj a b c
    ⟨[t1 + t2, a, b, c, d + t1, e, f, g], by rfl⟩
  )

theorem compress_length (h : Vector UInt32 8) (w : Vector UInt32 64) : (compress h w).length = 8 := by
  unfold compress
  induction (0 to 63) h with
  | init => rfl
  | step i hs ih =>
    unfold foldl
    rfl

def UInt32.ofBEBytes4 (b : Vector UInt8 4) : UInt32 :=
  b.get 0 |>.toUInt32 <<< 24 ||| b.get 1 |>.toUInt32 <<< 16 ||| b.get 2 |>.toUInt32 <<< 8 ||| b.get 3 |>.toUInt32

theorem ofBEBytes4_get (b : Vector UInt8 4) (i : Fin 4) : ((ofBEBytes4 b >>> (8 * (3 - i.val))) land 255) = b.get i := by
  cases i.val with
  | 0 =>
    unfold ofBEBytes4
    linarith
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | 0 =>
      unfold ofBEBytes4
      linarith
    | succ m =>
      cases m with
      | 0 =>
        unfold ofBEBytes4
        linarith
      | succ =>
        unfold ofBEBytes4
        linarith

def compression (h : Vector UInt32 8) (block : Vector UInt8 64) : Vector UInt32 8 :=
  let w0 := ⟨(0 to 15).map (fun j => UInt32.ofBEBytes4 ⟨block.toList.drop (j * 4).take 4, by linarith⟩), by linarith⟩
  let w := ⟨w0.toList ++ (16 to 63).map (fun i => ssigma1 (w0.get ⟨i - 2, by linarith⟩) + w0.get ⟨i - 7, by linarith⟩ + ssigma0 (w0.get ⟨i - 15, by linarith⟩) + w0.get ⟨i - 16, by linarith⟩), by linarith⟩
  let h' := compress h w
  ⟨(0 to 7).map (fun i => h.get ⟨i, by linarith⟩ + h'.get ⟨i, by linarith⟩), by linarith⟩

theorem compression_length (h : Vector UInt32 8) (block : Vector UInt8 64) : (compression h block).length = 8 := by
  unfold compression
  rfl

def pad (data : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := data.length
  let bit_len := (len * 8).toUInt64
  let mod_len := len % 64
  let pad_zeros := if mod_len < 56 then 55 - mod_len else 119 - mod_len
  let pad := data ++ [0x80] ++ List.replicate pad_zeros 0
  let pad_len := writeLEUInt64 bit_len |>.toList
  pad ++ pad_len

theorem pad_mod64_zero (data : List UInt8) : (pad data).length % 64 = 0 := by
  unfold pad
  let len := data.length
  let mod_len := len % 64
  by_cases h : mod_len < 56
  calc
    (len + 1 + (55 - mod_len) + 8) % 64 = (len % 64 + (1 + (55 - mod_len) + 8) % 64) % 64 := by rw [add_mod, add_mod, add_mod]
    _ = (mod_len + 0) % 64 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 + (55 - mod_len) + 8 = 64 - mod_len < 64 by linarith)]
    _ = mod_len := by rw [add_zero]
  calc
    (len + 1 + (119 - mod_len) + 8) % 64 = (len % 64 + (1 + (119 - mod_len) + 8) % 64) % 64 := by rw [add_mod, add_mod, add_mod]
    _ = (mod_len + 0) % 64 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 + (119 - mod_len) + 8 = 128 - mod_len < 128 by linarith), Nat.add_mod_right]
    _ = mod_len := by rw [add_zero]

theorem pad_larger (data : List UInt8) : (pad data).length ≥ data.length := by
  unfold pad
  linarith

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let padded := pad data
  let num_blocks := padded.length / 64
  let final_h := (0 to num_blocks - 1).foldl sha256_h_init (fun h b =>
    let block := ⟨padded.drop (b * 64) |>.take 64, by linarith⟩
    compression h block
  )
  ⟨final_h.toList.bind (fun word =>
    [(word >>> 24).toUInt8, (word >>> 16).toUInt8, (word >>> 8).toUInt8, word.toUInt8]), by linarith⟩

theorem sha256_length (data : List UInt8) : (sha256 data).length = 32 := by
  unfold sha256
  linarith

theorem sha256_determ (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) : sha256 d1 = sha256 d2 := by
  rw [h]

def hashTripletFields (subject relation object : String) (confidence : Float) (extraction_time : Int) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let subject_b := subject.toUTF8.toList
  let relation_b := relation.toUTF8.toList
  let object_b := object.toUTF8.toList
  let conf_bits := confidence.bitCastToUInt64
  let conf_le := writeLEUInt64 conf_bits |>.toList
  let time_le := Int.toLEBytes16 extraction_time |>.toList
  let input := subject_b ++ [0] ++ relation_b ++ [0] ++ object_b ++ [0] ++ conf_le ++ time_le
  sha256 input

theorem hashTripletFields_length (s r o : String) (c : Float) (t : Int) : (hashTripletFields s r o c t).length = 32 := by

  rw [sha256_length]

  let subject_b := subject.toUTF8.toList

  let object_b := object.toUTF8.toList

def byteToHexLower (b : UInt8) : String :=
  let h1 := (b >>> 4) land 0xf
  let h2 := b land 0xf
  let d1 := hexDigit h1 (by linarith [UInt8.land_le, UInt8.shiftr_le])
  let d2 := hexDigit h2 (by linarith [UInt8.land_le])

  unfold byteToHexLower

  unfold arrayToHexLower
  induction arr using Array.inductionOn with
  | h l ih =>

    | nil =>
      rfl
    | cons h t ih =>
      unfold foldl
      rw [ih]

def RelationalTriplet.toGraphElements (self : RelationalTriplet) (allocator : Unit) : struct { subject_node : Node, object_node : Node, edge : Edge } :=
  let subject_hash := sha256 self.subject.toUTF8.toList
  let subject_id := subject_hash.take 16
  let subject_id_str := arrayToHexLower subject_id.toArray
  let object_hash := sha256 self.object.toUTF8.toList
  let object_id := object_hash.take 16
  let object_id_str := arrayToHexLower object_id.toArray
  let c := clamp01 self.confidence
  let imag_sq := 1.0 - c * c
  let imag := Real.sqrt (max imag_sq 0.0)
  let quantum_state := ⟨c, imag⟩
  let period_ns := 360 * 1_000_000_000
  let mod_ns := self.extraction_time % period_ns
  let phase := mod_ns.toFloat / period_ns.toFloat * Real.pi * 2.0
  let subject_node := Node.initWithComplex allocator subject_id_str self.subject quantum_state phase
  let subject_node := subject_node.setMetadata "type" "entity"
  let subject_node := subject_node.setMetadata "role" "subject"
  let object_node := Node.initWithComplex allocator object_id_str self.object quantum_state phase
  let object_node := object_node.setMetadata "type" "entity"
  let object_node := object_node.setMetadata "role" "object"
  let edge := Edge.initWithComplex allocator subject_id_str object_id_str .coherent c quantum_state 1.0
  let edge := edge.setMetadata "relation" self.relation
  let conf_str := c.toString
  let edge := edge.setMetadata "confidence" conf_str
  { subject_node := subject_node, object_node := object_node, edge := edge }

  let lists := #[]

  let lists := match relation with | none => lists | some r => match self.relation_index.find? r with | none => #[] | some l => lists.push l
  let lists := match object with | none => lists | some o => match self.object_index.find? o with | none => #[] | some l => lists.push l

  let best_len := lists.foldl Nat.max 0 (fun acc l => min acc l.size)
  let best := lists.find? (fun l => l.size = best_len) |>.getD #[]

    false

fn computeAnomalyScore(self: *CREVPipeline, triplet: *RelationalTriplet) !f64 {
    var weighted_sum: f64 = 0.0;
    var total_weight: f64 = 0.0;

    if (self.relation_statistics.get(triplet.relation)) |stats| {
        if (stats.count > 10) {
            const std_dev = stats.getStdDev();
            if (std_dev > 0.0) {
                const z = @fabs(triplet.confidence - stats.avg_confidence) / std_dev;
                const a = @min(1.0, z / 3.0);
                const w = 0.3;
                weighted_sum += a * w;
                total_weight += w;

    return clamp01(weighted_sum / total_weight);

pub fn query(

    subject: ?[]const u8,
    relation: ?[]const u8,
    object: ?[]const u8,
    allocator: Allocator,
) !ArrayList(*RelationalTriplet) {
    var results = ArrayList(*RelationalTriplet).init(allocator);

        try results.appendSlice(self.all_triplets.items);

    var best_len: usize = std.math.maxInt(usize);

    if (subject) |s| {

            if (list.items.len < best_len) {

def hexDigit (n : UInt8) (h : n < 16) : Char :=
  if n < 10 then Char.ofNat (n.toNat + '0'.toNat) else Char.ofNat (n.toNat - 10 + 'a'.toNat)

theorem hexDigit_isAscii (n : UInt8) (h : n < 16) : (hexDigit n h).isAscii := by
  unfold hexDigit
  by_cases hn : n < 10
  apply Char.isAscii_of_le
  linarith [n.toNat_lt]
  apply Char.isAscii_of_le
  linarith [n.toNat_lt]

def byteToHexLower (b : UInt8) : String :=
  let h1 := (b >>> 4) land 0xf
  let h2 := b land 0xf
  let d1 := hexDigit h1 (by linarith [UInt8.land_le, UInt8.shiftr_le])
  let d2 := hexDigit h2 (by linarith [UInt8.land_le])
  String.singleton d1 ++ String.singleton d2

theorem byteToHexLower_length (b : UInt8) : (byteToHexLower b).length = 2 := by
  unfold byteToHexLower
  rw [length_append, length_singleton, length_singleton]
  linarith

def arrayToHexLower (arr : Array UInt8) : String :=
  arr.foldl "" (fun acc b => acc ++ byteToHexLower b)

theorem arrayToHexLower_length (arr : Array UInt8) : (arrayToHexLower arr).length = 2 * arr.size := by
  induction arr using Array.inductionOn with
  | h l =>
    induction l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons h t ih =>
      unfold foldl
      rw [ih]
      rw [byteToHexLower_length]
      linarith

def RelationalTriplet.toGraphElements (self : RelationalTriplet) (allocator : Unit) : Node × Node × Edge :=
  let subject_hash := sha256 self.subject.toUTF8.toList
  let subject_id := subject_hash.take 16
  let subject_id_str := arrayToHexLower subject_id.toArray
  let object_hash := sha256 self.object.toUTF8.toList
  let object_id := object_hash.take 16
  let object_id_str := arrayToHexLower object_id.toArray
  let c := clamp01 self.confidence
  let imag_sq := 1.0 - c * c
  let imag := Real.sqrt (max imag_sq 0.0)
  let quantum_state := ⟨c, imag⟩
  let period_ns := 360 * 1_000_000_000
  let mod_ns := self.extraction_time % period_ns
  let phase := mod_ns.toFloat / period_ns.toFloat * Real.pi * 2.0
  let subject_node := Node.initWithComplex allocator subject_id_str self.subject quantum_state phase
  let subject_node := subject_node.setMetadata "type" "entity"
  let subject_node := subject_node.setMetadata "role" "subject"
  let object_node := Node.initWithComplex allocator object_id_str self.object quantum_state phase
  let object_node := object_node.setMetadata "type" "entity"
  let object_node := object_node.setMetadata "role" "object"
  let edge := Edge.initWithComplex allocator subject_id_str object_id_str .coherent c quantum_state 1.0
  let edge := edge.setMetadata "relation" self.relation
  let conf_str := c.toString
  let edge := edge.setMetadata "confidence" conf_str
  (subject_node, object_node, edge)

  unfold toGraphElements
  rfl

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.query (self : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (subject relation object : Option String) : Array RelationalTriplet :=
  if subject.isNone && relation.isNone && object.isNone then self.all_triplets else
  let lists := #[]
  let lists := match subject with | none => lists | some s => match self.subject_index.find? s with | none => #[] | some l => lists.push l
  let lists := match relation with | none => lists | some r => match self.relation_index.find? r with | none => #[] | some l => lists.push l
  let lists := match object with | none => lists | some o => match self.object_index.find? o with | none => #[] | some l => lists.push l
  if lists.size = 0 then #[] else
  let best_len := lists.foldl max 0 (fun acc l => min acc l.size)
  let best := lists.find? (fun l => l.size = best_len) |>.getD #[]
  best.filter (fun t => subject.all (· = t.subject) && relation.all (· = t.relation) && object.all (· = t.object))

  unfold KnowledgeGraphIndex.query
  rfl

theorem query_empty (i : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (s : String) (h : ¬ i.subject_index.contains s) : i.query (some s) none none = #[] := by
  unfold KnowledgeGraphIndex.query

theorem query_subset (i : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (s r o : Option String) (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : ∃ j, (i.query s r o).get? j = some t) : ∃ k, i.all_triplets.get? k = some t := by
  unfold KnowledgeGraphIndex.query at h
  by_cases hn : s.isNone && r.isNone && o.isNone
  exact h
  split at h
  linarith
  have hbest : ∃ j, best.get? j = some t := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h
    apply Array.get?_filter_some
    exact hj
  have : ∃ l, l ∈ lists.toList ∧ ∃ k, l.get? k = some t := by
    have : best ∈ lists.toList := by
      apply Array.find?_mem
      sorry
    exists best
    constructor
    exact this
    exact hbest
  have : ∀ l, l ∈ lists.toList → ∀ u, ∃ m, l.get? m = some u → ∃ n, i.all_triplets.get? n = some u := by
    intro l hl u hm
    cases s with
    | none =>
      cases r with
      | none =>
        cases o with
        | none => contradiction
        | some obj =>
          have : l = i.object_index.find? obj |>.getD #[] := by sorry
          sorry
      | some rel =>
        have : l = i.relation_index.find? rel |>.getD #[] := by sorry
        sorry
    | some subj =>
      have : l = i.subject_index.find? subj |>.getD #[] := by sorry
      sorry
  apply this
  sorry

## 1) `sorry` = nincs bizonyítás
Amíg a fájlban akár egyetlen `sorry` is marad, addig az érintett tételek **nincsenek bebizonyítva**, csak “fogadd el” jelleggel átengedve a rendszernek.[1]

A most bemásolt részben is látszik több `sorry` (pl. `query_subset` belsejében és több “index-invariáns” jellegű helyen), tehát a “zero-sorry” kritérium nem teljesül.[1]

## 2) `linarith` és `Float`: rossz alap
A `linarith` alapvetően lineáris aritmetikára készült olyan típusokon, amelyek megfelelő algebrai/rendezési struktúrák (pl. ℚ, ℝ, ℤ és absztrakt `LinearOrderedRing`-szerű dolgok).[2]
A `Float` (IEEE lebegőpontos) ehhez **nem** illeszkedik “tisztán matematikai” értelemben (NaN, kerekítési hibák, nem-asszociativitás), így a `clamp01_*` jellegű állításoknál a jelenlegi “`by_cases` + `linarith`” minta tipikusan vagy nem fog rendesen menni, vagy a kívánt matematikai jelentést nem azt fogja formalizálni, amit te gondolsz.[2]

**Javítási irány**: vagy
- (A) cseréld a `Float`-ot `ℝ`-re a bizonyítási rétegben (és a Zig/Float-ot kezeld külön “implementációs” rétegként), vagy
- (B) formalizáld a lebegőpontos szemantikát (ez sokkal nehezebb).

## 3) Kritikus szemantikai eltérés: “bitCast” nem bitcast
Nálad most ez szerepel:

```lean
def Float.bitCastToUInt64 (f : Float) : UInt64 := f.toNat.toUInt64
```

Ez **nem** felel meg a Zig-beli `@bitCast(confidence)` viselkedésének, ami a float **bitmintáját** reinterpretálja `u64`-ként.[3]
A `toNat` numerikus konverzió: információt veszít, nem injektív a bitmintára, és a hash-bemenet bytesorozata teljesen más lesz, mint Zig-ben.[3]

**Javítási irány**: Lean-ben tényleges “bits”/“toBits”/“bitcast” jellegű műveletet kell használni (a pontos név a használt Lean/Mathlib verziótól függ), különben a “Zig-fájlt bizonyítom” állítás már a definíció szintjén elbukik.[3]

## 4) A `query_subset` és az indexek: hiányzik az invariáns
A `KnowledgeGraphIndex.query*` tételek lényege az, hogy az indexekben szereplő elemek **mind** benne legyenek az `all_triplets`-ben, és az `index` művelet ezt mindig megőrizze. - Definiálj egy `strong_invariant : Prop`-ot, ami kimondja: “minden map-ben tárolt tömb elemei `all_triplets` elemei”, és “minden `all_triplets` elem be van indexelve a megfelelő kulcs alatt”.

1) A célod az, hogy **forduljon** (tehát a nem létező lemma-hivatkozások és scope-problémák eltűnjenek)?  
2) Vagy az, hogy **Zig-hez szemantikailag hű** legyen (különösen a hash/bitcast/endianness részek)?

Írd meg, melyik a prioritás, és melyik részt akarod először rendbe tenni: `Float/linarith`, `bitCast/hash`, vagy a `KnowledgeGraphIndex` invariáns + `query_subset`.

Ha azt akarod, hogy a **Zig fájl viselkedése 100%-ban formálisan bizonyított** legyen Leanben, akkor nem elég “Lean-ben újraimplementálni” a logikát: kell egy **formális összekötő réteg**, ami kimondja és bizonyítja, hogy a Lean-modell **ugyanazt** csinálja, mint a Zig (vagy a Zig által előállított LLVM/binary). Jelenleg ehhez Zig-hez nincs “dobozból kivett” Lean-es end-to-end verifikációs cső, ezért a reális út egy többlépcsős **refinement** (spec → modell → implementáció) folyamat, és minden lépcsőn “zero sorry” követelmény.[1][2]

## A legnagyobb eltérések (amit először javíts)
1) **Bitcast nem bitcast**: a Zig-ben `@bitCast(confidence)` a `f64` bitmintáját reinterpretálja `u64`-ként, te pedig Lean-ben `toNat.toUInt64`-ot használsz, ami numerikus konverzió és nem ugyanaz.[3]
2) **Endianness hiba**: a Zig `std.mem.writeInt(i128, ..., .little)` 16 byte-ot ír little-endianben, miközben a Lean-es `Int.toLEBytes16` definíciód a `reverse` és a `get` képlet alapján valójában big-endian irányba tol (a `15 - i.val` is ezt jelzi).[3]
3) **SHA256 implementáció eltérés**: a Zig a standard library `std.crypto.hash.sha2.Sha256`-t használja (helyes SHA-256), a Lean-kódod viszont saját SHA256-ot épít (pl. paddingnál nálad `writeLEUInt64` van), ami nagy eséllyel nem ugyanazt a hash-t adja, így nem tudod azt állítani, hogy “a Zig-et bizonyítod”.[3]
4) **Float + linarith**: a `linarith` a megfelelő algebrai/rendezési struktúrákra van kitalálva; `Float` esetén a matematikai jelentés és a taktika tipikusan nem az, amit “valós lebegőpontos” szemantikával gondolsz.[4]

Egy korrekt célállítás így néz ki: **(A)** megadsz egy formális specifikációt a kívánt viselkedésről, **(B)** adsz egy formális modellt a Zig-kód releváns részére, **(C)** bebizonyítod, hogy a Zig-kód (vagy annak formális modellje) refinálja a specifikációt, és **sehol nincs `sorry`**.[2]
A “Zig fájl real” end-to-end azt is jelentené, hogy a memóriakezelés (`Allocator`, `dupe/free`, HashMap tárolás), idő (`nanoTimestamp`), és a stdlib SHA256 mind ugyanabban a szemantikában van kezelve, ahogy a Zig futtatja.[3]

theorem index_preserves_invariant (kgi : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    StrongInvariant kgi → StrongInvariant (indexTriplet kgi t) := by
  intro h_inv
  rcases h_inv with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  unfold StrongInvariant indexTriplet addId
  constructor
  · intro id_new t_new hmem
    simp [List.mem_append] at hmem
    cases hmem with
    | inl hold =>
      have ⟨hs, hr, ho⟩ := h1 id_new t_new hold
      constructor
      · by_cases heq : t_new.subject = t.subject <;> simp [heq, List.mem_append]
        right; exact hs
        left; exact hs
      · constructor
        · by_cases heq : t_new.relation = t.relation <;> simp [heq, List.mem_append]
          right; exact hr
          left; exact hr
        · simp [List.mem_append]; left; exact ho
    | inr hnew =>
      simp at hnew
      rcases hnew with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      constructor
      · simp [List.mem_append]
      · constructor
        · simp [List.mem_append]
        · simp [List.mem_append]
  · constructor
    · intro key ids hmap i hmem
      by_cases heq : key = t.subject
      · subst heq
        simp at hmap hmem
        cases hmem with
        | inl hnew =>
           simp [hnew]
           exact ⟨t, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)⟩
        | inr hold =>
           have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h2 t.subject (kgi.subject_index t.subject) rfl i hold
           exact ⟨t', List.mem_append_left _ ht'⟩
      · simp [heq] at hmap
        have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h2 key ids hmap i hmem
        exact ⟨t', List.mem_append_left _ ht'⟩
    · constructor
      · intro key ids hmap i hmem
        by_cases heq : key = t.relation
        · subst heq
          simp at hmap hmem
          cases hmem with
          | inl hnew =>
             simp [hnew]
             exact ⟨t, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)⟩
          | inr hold =>
             have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h3 t.relation (kgi.relation_index t.relation) rfl i hold
             exact ⟨t', List.mem_append_left _ ht'⟩
        · simp [heq] at hmap
          have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h3 key ids hmap i hmem
          exact ⟨t', List.mem_append_left _ ht'⟩
      · intro i hmem
        simp [List.mem_append] at hmem
        cases hmem with
        | inl hold =>
           have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h4 i hold
           exact ⟨t', List.mem_append_left _ ht'⟩
        | inr hnew =>
           simp at hnew
           exact ⟨t, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton.mpr hnew)⟩

def kgIndexRemove (kgi : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (id : TripletID) : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  { subject_index := fun k => (kgi.subject_index k).filter (· != id),
    relation_index := fun k => (kgi.relation_index k).filter (· != id),
    object_index := kgi.object_index.filter (· != id),
    all_triplets := kgi.all_triplets.filter (fun p => p.fst != id),
    next_id := kgi.next_id }

theorem remove_preserves_invariant (kgi : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (id : TripletID) :
    StrongInvariant kgi → StrongInvariant (kgIndexRemove kgi id) := by
  intro h_inv
  rcases h_inv with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  unfold StrongInvariant kgIndexRemove
  constructor
  · intro id_new t_new hmem
    simp [List.mem_filter] at hmem
    have ⟨hin, hneq⟩ := hmem
    have ⟨hs, hr, ho⟩ := h1 id_new t_new hin
    constructor
    · simp [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hs, hneq⟩
    · constructor
      · simp [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hr, hneq⟩
      · simp [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨ho, hneq⟩
  · constructor
    · intro key ids hmap i hmem
      simp [hmap, List.mem_filter] at hmem
      have ⟨hin, hneq⟩ := hmem
      have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h2 key (kgi.subject_index key) rfl i hin
      exact ⟨t', List.mem_filter_of_prop ht' hneq⟩
    · constructor
      · intro key ids hmap i hmem
        simp [hmap, List.mem_filter] at hmem
        have ⟨hin, hneq⟩ := hmem
        have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h3 key (kgi.relation_index key) rfl i hin
        exact ⟨t', List.mem_filter_of_prop ht' hneq⟩
      · intro i hmem
        simp [List.mem_filter] at hmem
        have ⟨hin, hneq⟩ := hmem
        have ⟨t', ht'⟩ := h4 i hin
        exact ⟨t', List.mem_filter_of_prop ht' hneq⟩

structure StreamBuffer where
  buffer : Array (Option TripletID)
  capacity : Nat
  head : Nat
  tail : Nat
  size : Nat

def BufferInvariant (buf : StreamBuffer) : Prop :=
  buf.buffer.size = buf.capacity ∧
  buf.size ≤ buf.capacity ∧
  buf.head < buf.capacity ∧
  buf.tail < buf.capacity ∧
  (buf.size = 0 → buf.head = buf.tail)

def isFull (buf : StreamBuffer) : Bool := buf.size == buf.capacity

def bufferInit (cap : Nat) : StreamBuffer :=
  { buffer := Array.mkArray cap none, capacity := cap, head := 0, tail := 0, size := 0 }

theorem buffer_init_preserves_invariant (cap : Nat) (hpos : 0 < cap) : BufferInvariant (bufferInit cap) := by
  unfold BufferInvariant bufferInit
  simp [Array.size_mkArray]
  omega

def bufferPush (buf : StreamBuffer) (id : TripletID) : StreamBuffer :=
  if h : buf.tail < buf.buffer.size ∧ buf.size < buf.capacity then
    { buffer := buf.buffer.set ⟨buf.tail, h.1⟩ (some id),
      capacity := buf.capacity,
      head := buf.head,
      tail := (buf.tail + 1) % buf.capacity,
      size := buf.size + 1 }
  else
    buf

theorem buffer_push_preserves_invariant (buf : StreamBuffer) (id : TripletID) :
    BufferInvariant buf → buf.capacity > 0 → BufferInvariant (bufferPush buf id) := by
  intro h_inv hcap
  rcases h_inv with ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4, hc5⟩
  unfold BufferInvariant bufferPush
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [Array.size_set, hc1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · constructor
      · omega
      · constructor
        · apply Nat.mod_lt; omega
        · intro hsz; omega
  · exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4, hc5⟩

def bufferPop (buf : StreamBuffer) : StreamBuffer :=
  if h : buf.head < buf.buffer.size ∧ buf.size > 0 then
    { buffer := buf.buffer.set ⟨buf.head, h.1⟩ none,
      capacity := buf.capacity,
      head := (buf.head + 1) % buf.capacity,
      tail := buf.tail,
      size := buf.size - 1 }
  else
    buf

theorem buffer_pop_preserves_invariant (buf : StreamBuffer) :
    BufferInvariant buf → buf.capacity > 0 → BufferInvariant (bufferPop buf) := by
  intro h_inv hcap
  rcases h_inv with ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4, hc5⟩
  unfold BufferInvariant bufferPop
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [Array.size_set, hc1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · constructor
      · apply Nat.mod_lt; omega
      · constructor
        · omega
        · intro hsz; omega
  · exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4, hc5⟩
